improve.title: Defensive work rate
tips: As a CDM/CM, screen the back line: stay between the ball and our goal and pick off passes.
When the ball is lost, the nearest player presses and everyone else closes the passing lanes.
Make yourself big in the box when they shoot. Blocks count, even if the stats don't.
improve.coach: It's come up in 45% of your matches, but only 20% lately. You're winning this one.

improve.title: Forcing passes
tips: Through balls only when the runner is already moving and on the last defender's shoulder.
Use the keeper and center-backs to reset. Recycling is how good teams find the gap.
Before the killer ball, check: is my runner onside, moving, and unmarked? Two out of three isn't enough.
improve.coach: It's shown up in 45% of your matches and it's holding steady. Let's crack it.

improve.title: Passing accuracy
tips: Open your hips to the field when you receive. Side-on body shape turns a back pass into a forward one.
Weight matters as much as direction. Firm along the ground beats soft and loopy.
Simple and on the ground to the open, facing teammate. Driven and lofted balls are for clear lanes only.
improve.coach: 36% of matches, right in line with your recent form. A good one to drill.

strengths.title: Goal threat
strengths.coach: Scoring's a lot like karaoke: confidence is half of it. Shows up in 64% of your matches. That's a calling card.

strengths.title: Chance creation
strengths.coach: A good pass is a love note. You wrote a few. 45% of the time. Teammates can count on it.

coach.intro: Alright tuxedo_slide, 11 matches in. Let's talk patterns, the good and the growing.
